scenicChapters.title: Dutch Flower Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 20 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Segment San Juan de Tantaranche - Huarochi → Segment Casila Alto - Chi
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 45 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-segment-portachuelo-laguna-escale.story: 223 km from Tanta to Tanta, about 3 h 51 of riding. It goes by way of Segment San Juan de Tantaranche - Huarochi, Segment Casila Alto - Chillaco, Segment Sisicaya - Santa Rosa de Chontay and back through Segment Casila Alto - Chillaco. The highest point is about 4,700 m. The line favours views over speed.

legend-oxley-highway.story: A mountain highway from Wauchope, New South Wales to Walcha, New South Wales, via Gingers Creek. Key character: rainforest; escarpment; long bend sequences. Surface: paved.

scenicChapters.title: Oxley Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 17 km this is Oxley Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
